## ACCEPT · objectui#13020 · PR #13026 · `domain:ui#2` · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-19T07:01Z

PR #13026 at head `34333e3` (`Fixes #13020`), reviewed against the claim `6260311187` and the dev report `6261103441`. The maintainer's ruling 「A+C」 is quoted on the card; this card is C.

- **Diff read by the seat (22 files, +779/−4):**
  - **Index:** `/apps/APP/reports` (`AppReportIndexView`, lazy, with an `APP_ROUTE_CHUNKS` row and an `APP_ROUTE_METADATA_READS` row of `['report']`, so no whole `meta/object` read). It lists the reports whose `_packageId` is the app's (a package-less app lists the reports no package owns), by localized label, each linking to `report/NAME`, with an empty state.
  - **Read rule:** a report is left out when any object its datasets read (`dataset`, or each `blocks[].dataset`, through the dataset's `object`) fails `mayReadObject`, the console's one object-read verdict (`navObjectReadGate`). Its inputs are the cached `/meta/dataset` list and the permissions the shell already holds.
  - **Placement:** one static sidebar entry, 「All reports」, after the app navigation in every app but Studio. It reads no report list.
  - **⌘K:** while open inside an app, it offers the same entries by label and name, minus the reports a nav entry already names, so nothing is shown twice.
- **Measured mechanism correction:** `ReportView` has no client-side read check (it opens, and the server refuses the dataset query). So the index uses `mayReadObject` on the dataset objects; no new verdict was invented.
- **Clause-②: no.** A console route and palette entries; no package export, prop or authored key. Changeset `@object-ui/app-shell: minor` (a new user-visible route) and `@object-ui/i18n: minor` (new keys in every shipped locale; both packages are in the fixed group).
- **Accepted deviations:**
  - The new strings live in `packages/i18n/src/locales/*` (where app-shell's console strings ship), in all 10 locales.
  - A second helper module, `views/appReportIndex.ts`, keeps the palette from importing the lazy view.
  - One `appRouteMetadataReads.ts` row.
  - Two sidebar row-enumeration pins (`favoritesMenu-12427`, `iconModeLabelFocus-12795`) updated for the new row, in their own commit.
- **Pins:** `AppReportIndex-13020` (8):
  - (a) a report not in the navigation appears in the index and in ⌘K for a reader;
  - (b) a report on an unreadable object appears in neither;
  - CONTROLs: the exact list, the nav-entry path unchanged, no duplicate in ⌘K.

  Also `UnifiedSidebar.reportIndexLink-13020` (3), and `appRouteChunks-12980` / `appRouteMetadataReads-12809` now assert the `reports` rows. Ablation (read filter made always-true) turned (b), the palette cases and the exact-list CONTROL red; the restore was proven by blob hash.
- **Local gates (dev report):** app-shell families 60 / 60 / 28 files and i18n 84 files, all green; `i18n` + `app-shell` type-check 0; eslint 0 errors on the 19 changed files; the pre-tsc battery and the changeset checks all 0. The full `packages/app-shell/` dir is declared to CI.
- **Fix round (`34333e3`, test-only):** the first CI run failed `Test (shard 15/16)`: `vite-declared-lazy-views` counts the lazy modules `AppContent` declares, and the new view made 12. The dev checked for a second list to keep in sync: `apps/console/vite.config.ts` names no views, and the hand-kept `DECLARED_LAZY_VIEWS_STILL_EAGER` lists only still-eager views. So only the count moved to 12, with the new file named explicitly. The console build reports the view genuinely lazy (its own ~0.95 kB gz chunk, absent from `eager-closure.json`), and `check:eager-closure` passes (3167.1 / 3744.1 KB gz).
- **Commits:** trailers are model-free.
- **Acceptance notes:**
  - A dataset not found in the `/meta/dataset` list counts as readable (the report shows, and the server refuses its query on open). The index never hides a report it cannot judge.
  - Nav entries of type `report` are still drawn without a read check (objectui#12109); the card pins that path unchanged.
  - An object literally named `reports` is shadowed by the index route, as `search` already is; none is known.
  - Pre-spec reports keyed by `objectName` / `dataSource.object` are not read-gated; the index reads the spec's `dataset` only.
- **CI at head:** 36/36 check-runs success or skipped on `34333e3` (filter=latest), `mergeable_state` clean.

Verdict: **ACCEPT**. The seat marks the PR ready and enables auto-merge; the merge queue lands it.
